name: Blog Pipeline Agent
description: Parent orchestrator (WayFlow Flow OAS) that turns one stored blog idea into a reviewed blog post, its featured image and the LinkedIn post that announces it. Manual brief and reference material only; transcript input is not accepted. Four pauses of its own: the brand-voice pick the draft and its picture are made in, then the stored-ideas gate, the review the run parks at, and the LinkedIn post.

cinatra.inputContract: Manual brief / reference artifacts only. Transcript input is DROPPED.

read_brand_voice.name: Read the picked brand voice as text

input.bindings: {# pyagentspec-input-hint (do not remove): {{ brandVoiceContextSlotBindings }} #}{{ brandVoiceContextSlotBindings | tojson }}

cinatra.description: The consumer of the run's one brand-voice pick, right after the list step the host draws for it: it reads the picked brand voice's text through the tool this pack declares, so a brand voice that cannot be read as text (a PDF) stops the run with one sentence before an idea is taken or a draft is written. The writer and the image generator read the same pick themselves.

prepare_ideas.name: Read the organisation's unused blog ideas

cinatra.description: The preparation step of plan (C) section 5.1: it lists every blog idea the organisation holds through the dependency this extension declares, reads each unused one, subtracts the ideas a draft already used or another run reserved, and hands the rest to the gate as the list a person chooses from. An empty list comes back with the sentence the run ends on, never with a pick.

emit_ideas_payload.name: Emit offered ideas as agent message
emit_ideas_payload.message: {# pyagentspec-input-hint (do not remove): {{ ideas }} #}{"ideas":{{ ideas | tojson }}}

cinatra.description: The stored-ideas gate of plan (C) section 5.1. The list is the organisation's own unused blog ideas, read by the preparation step in front of this gate: a person picks exactly one and nothing is picked for them. The pick commits the idea's artifact and the exact revision the list offered, as one JSON string (an InputMessageNode emits one string output), never a title and never free text. The pick is declared "x-required": true, so while ideas are offered the host keeps the step's Continue unavailable until a person picks one. With no idea left the list arrives empty with the reason the run ends on, and the reason is what the person reads; the step's renderer then answers the pick with the no-pick value {"noPick":true}, which names no idea, so a person who reads that sentence can continue and the run ends at the step after this one with a plain reason and nothing reserved, instead of parking at a pause nothing can answer. A pick that names no offered idea ends the run the same way: nothing is ever picked for them. The brief and the idea count travel with the list for the road that asks for new ideas.

reserve_idea.name: Take the chosen idea for this run

input.offered: {# pyagentspec-input-hint (do not remove): {{ ideas }} #}{{ ideas | tojson }}

cinatra.description: The pick is the reservation (plan (C) section 5.1): the chosen artifact and revision are validated against the very list the person was shown and written as one reservation row under the rule that allows one live row per idea, so of two runs offering the same idea only one takes it and the loser is told so. The idea's own words come back as the draft writer's one input. A refused pick answers with its reason and none of the three fields below, which carry no default: the run ends there rather than drafting an idea nobody chose.

Child generation FlowNode to @cinatra-ai/blog-draft-writer-agent, at the one input its own repository now takes: the chosen idea as plain text. It answers with the post's title, its excerpt and its markdown, which the step after this one writes as the run's own blog-post artifact.

write_draft.name: Write the draft as this run's blog post

cinatra.description: The mid-run write of plan (C) section 6.1 step 3: the draft becomes a blog-post artifact while the run is still going, so the review that follows opens on an immutable revision of the real post instead of on loose text. The reference it returns is what the projection hands the review step and what the picture is filed against.

Child FlowNode to @cinatra-ai/blog-image-generator-agent, the image maker the retired prompt writer became. It runs on the post the run just wrote and before the review, so the review sees the post with its featured image. This step settles the featured image's prompt and its alternative text; the next step files the picture through the host's image tool, and the review's target set names it after the post.

blog-image-generator-agent-subflow.name: Blog Image Generator Agent
blog-image-generator-agent-subflow.description: Stub of the subflow: its inputs and outputs only.

input.title: {{ title }}
input.dataJson: {# pyagentspec-input-hint (do not remove): {{ image }} {{ postArtifactId }} #}{"post":{{ postArtifactId | tojson }},"placement":"featured","altText":{{ image.altText | tojson }}}

cinatra.description: The featured image the step before settled is filed here as an image through the host's image tool, named after the post and carrying the post it belongs to, its placement and its alternative text. The reference it returns is what the review's target set names second.

complete_relation.name: Record this idea's draft and gather the review's targets

cinatra.description: Two sentences of plan (C) section 6.1 in one call. It completes the reservation into the relation row — this idea, this draft, keyed by immutable claim, run and idea so a retry completes the same row and never a second — and it is the projection step of section 8.4: the call echoes its own input back, so the immutable reference the mid-run write returned reaches the review step as the set the marker below names. The set names the post first and its featured image second. The call answers with the completion own ok flag, so a completion that did not land is visible in the run rather than hidden behind the echo; the run does not branch on it here, and an uncompleted reservation lapses on its own.

emit_draft_payload.name: Emit generated draft as agent message
emit_draft_payload.message: {# pyagentspec-input-hint (do not remove): {{ content }} #}{"draft":{"content":{{ content | tojson }}}}

cinatra.description: The review of plan (C) section 6.1 step 4. The marker below names the input this gate carries the run's own target set in, so the review core pins exactly the revisions the run minted and opens one review per artifact while the run parks here. The decision is the lifecycle's, not this flow's: this flow owns the pause. The set names the post today and each picture as well once the host's image tool files one.

blog-linkedin-writer-agent-subflow.name: Blog LinkedIn Writer Agent
blog-linkedin-writer-agent-subflow.description: Stub of the subflow: its inputs and outputs only.

write_linkedin.name: Write the LinkedIn post as this run's post draft

cinatra.description: The LinkedIn post the writer made is written here as a LinkedIn post draft while the run is still going, so the review that follows opens on an immutable revision of the real post instead of on loose text. The reference it returns is what the next step hands the review.

gather_linkedin_review.name: Gather the LinkedIn post's review target

cinatra.description: The projection step of the LinkedIn post's review: the call files the immutable reference the write before returned, and the host answers with the set it validated, so that set reaches the review step as the input the marker below names. The set names the LinkedIn post alone; the call writes no row and answers with its own ok flag.

The last pause of plan (C) section 6.1 step 5: the review of the LinkedIn post the writer made from the revision the person continued with. The post is written as a LinkedIn post draft before this step, and the marker below names the input its reference travels in, so the review core pins exactly that revision and opens its review while the run parks here. The decision is the lifecycle's, not this flow's: this flow owns the pause. The publishing steps are their own agents and are not in this flow.
